title: Graphic Design Intern
note: Windows and doors brand; summer intern cohort.

facts.summary: In-house graphic design intern on Andersen Windows & Doors' creative team, working with the Sr. Graphic Designer and social media specialists.
facts.duties: Designs digital and print assets such as social graphics, email templates, web visuals, presentations and promo pieces; helps build a template/asset library; designs visuals for video, photo and social campaigns.
facts.requirements: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign; Premiere Pro/After Effects a bonus; solid grasp of typography, color and layout.
facts.apply: Apply on Andersen's Workday career site (req R-8369).
